text: {"assertions":["On 2026-04-02, a latency spike was discovered in ml/serving/batcher.py affecting clients using the v1 SDK.","The root cause of the latency spike was a naive datetime being compared against a timezone-aware datetime.","The fix involved making all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge and was submitted as PR #5437 on branch fix/latency-spike-1.","The performance improvement from this fix was significant: jobs completed in 41 minutes instead of 6 hours.","The issue could be reproduced by sending mixed-size request traces.","The test coverage for this fix is located in tests/ml/test_batcher.py."]}
